answer: Each identity must file a sonnet at the oasis, posting a bond; every gale burns all posted bonds and voids the filings. An operator must refile its entire bundle at once, and the oasis prices the next sonnet at the total bond already posted for that bundle: one filing posts one bond, two post three, ten post 1,023, a thousand post 2^1000−1. Staggering fails because the gale clears every filing together; splitting fails because the oasis prices the bundle by its current size.
